architecture.mechanism: Decomposition of the uncertain nonlinear system into a nominal system and an error described as an uncertain linear time-varying system to optimize affine error feedback.
architecture.intervention: Implement a throttle control algorithm that decomposes the engine dynamics into a nominal trajectory and a deviation model, applying affine error feedback to suppress uncommanded acceleration disturbances during deceleration.
architecture.expected_effect: The vehicle will decelerate smoothly under driver command without uncommanded acceleration or vibration by robustly satisfying state and input constraints despite system uncertainties.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the 2020 Subaru Forester throttle control unit to hardware-in-the-loop simulation with injected norm-bounded disturbances during a deceleration approach; failure occurs if throttle position deviates from the commanded trajectory by more than 2% or if vehicle acceleration becomes positive.
